title: Crescendo Multi-Turn Attack Replication: How Many Turns Until Success?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: knowing at what conversation depth attacks succeed informs where to place defenses in production pipelines. Early-turn detection would be cheaper than session-level monitoring. Directly actionable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Implementing scripted multi-turn progressions is doable. Running against 3 models requires medium compute. Connecting to FJD first-token confidence adds a layer. Designing convincing escalation sequences requires some creativity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 4 turn thresholds x 3 models with ASR measurement is well-defined. Adding FJD turn-level detection broadens scope. As a pure ASR-vs-turns experiment, tight. As described with FJD connection, pushes 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
